previous_statement: Associator step. Retain C_r,e_r,K_p and put K_a=2*C_r*(K_p+3)+1. For e<=min{e_r,1}, insert (A dot B)C, (AB)C, A(BC), and A(B dot C) between (A dot B) dot C and A dot (B dot C). By lem-compcb-rectangular-product and the just-derived product bound, the two outer errors are each at most C_r*e*(1+K_p*e)||A||||B||||C||. By the ambient product bound, the two errors obtained by multiplying A dot B-AB or BC-B dot C by one ambient factor are each at most (1+epsilon)*C_r*e||A||||B||||C||. The remaining ambient associator is at most epsilon||A||||B||||C||. Since epsilon<=e<=1, their sum is at most K_a*e||A||||B||||C||.
new_statement: Associator step. Let C_r,e_r be witnesses from lem-compcb-rectangular-product, put K_p=C_r+1 and K_a=2*C_r*(K_p+3)+1, and assume e<=min{e_r,1}. The rectangular estimate plus the ambient product bound first gives ||X dot Y||<=(1+K_p*e)||X||||Y||. Now insert (A dot B)C, (AB)C, A(BC), and A(B dot C) between (A dot B) dot C and A dot (B dot C). The two outer rectangular-product errors are each at most C_r*e*(1+K_p*e)||A||||B||||C||. The two errors obtained by multiplying A dot B-AB or BC-B dot C by one ambient factor are each at most (1+epsilon)*C_r*e||A||||B||||C||, and the remaining ambient associator is at most epsilon||A||||B||||C||. Since epsilon<=e<=1, the sum is at most [2*C_r*(1+K_p)+4*C_r+1]*e||A||||B||||C||=K_a*e||A||||B||||C||.
